name: Cerner Transfer Center
use_note: Built from a live field survey of the Cerner Transfer Center case form (Terra/React UI). Most fields have no usable id or placeholder, so 'label:' selectors match by visible label text (leading * ignored). 'date:' handles the split month|day|year Terra date picker. Element ids embed random per-case hashes, so the few id selectors match stable prefixes/suffixes. Grab (reading values) works on all of these; pushing values into '- Select -' comboboxes shows the text but may not register a selection in Cerner — treat combobox fills as a visual aid and confirm manually.
